survivors.claim: cmdRefreshRegister derives its PRE-RENAME/CURRENT classification from a hand-spelled KEPT_ROLE_NAMES list in mocks-driver.js (border, primary, ring, radius, font, shadow) rather than from anything wire-roles.js exports, so the kept-name half of D6 is spelled once in the lib header comment and once as data in the driver; a future role that keeps its name must be added in two places or the classification silently misfiles it as a new-only name and refuses every retired host.
survivors.impact: A later register change that adds a same-named role could make the migration command refuse hosts it should migrate, with no test catching the split.
survivors.evidence: spec/scripts/mocks-driver.js:322 `const KEPT_ROLE_NAMES = [border, primary, ring, radius, font, shadow]`; spec/scripts/lib/wire-roles.js:210-211 restates the same six names in prose only. D6 sanctions the map living once; the kept set is outside the map, so this is convention drift, not a Decision violation.
